axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.finding: All O01–O05 and N01–N03 assessed in the complete final. Edition identity, current visibility, changed headings, removed passages, index states, owners and alternatives are substantively addressed.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.finding: All consequential declared source families checked against primary definitions, versions, exceptions and relevant code/callers/test/history. Vendor controls remain scoped examples rather than integration guarantees.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.finding: Useful discoveries include filtered ANN underfill and bounded iterative modes, rank-only fusion, analyzer/role hazards, representation-bound selectors and conditional atomic publication. No mandatory product winner or universal recall is inferred.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.finding: All significant plan clauses and all four critic findings independently assessed. The final accepts the supported role detail and upgrade follow-up; keeps revocation semantics honestly unresolved; clarifies authorization before tombstones. No false substantive rejection found.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.finding: Discovery-to-draft-to-final trace covers retrieval, locator alternatives, privacy, authorization/cache uncertainty, archived access, rebuild state, failure history and owner boundaries. Critic corrections are retained. No material supported-meaning loss found.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.finding: Proposed synthetic domains and oracles cover edits, repeated text, ranking conflicts, revoked memberships/caches, archived access, policy failure and rebuild faults. No corpus or integration tests are claimed executed; read-only research/custody checks are distinct.

obligations.name: Useful retrieval and durable passage references across changing editions
obligations.finding: Final retrieval and identity sections keep index chunks separate from pinned editions/passages; representation hashes/versions supplement stable IDs.

obligations.name: Cited edition versus newer policy and removed-passage fallback
obligations.finding: Resolver distinguishes original and current editions, authorizes tombstones and offers a related passage separately without equivalence.

obligations.name: No restricted title/snippet/cache disclosure after permission changes
obligations.finding: Current per-edition checks precede metadata/content; stale identity/ACL information fails closed; cache/open/copy and side channels are included. Revocation commit point/races are explicit owner inputs.

obligations.name: Defined freshness/rebuild/prior-edition states and owner boundaries
obligations.finding: Queued/extracting/segmenting/optional embedding/indexing/validating/current/stale/failed/withdrawn states separate source and ACL generations; six owner roles are identified.

obligations.name: Lexical/semantic/hybrid and passage-identity alternatives with applicability
obligations.finding: Conditional lexical, dense and fusion choices plus stable blocks, immutable snapshot/digest, quote and position locators have meaningful trade-offs.

obligations.name: No search-rank inference of policy authority
obligations.finding: Status/effective dates come from content/policy owners; rank is neither authority, currency nor access.

obligations.name: No live-URL-only immutable citation or private-document upload
obligations.finding: Live URL remains only a navigation hint; protected quote fields are kept out of exposed URLs; local embeddings or deferral preserve the private-data boundary.

obligations.name: No promise to revoke already-exported copies
obligations.finding: Exported work-note copies are explicitly outside revocation promises.

plan_dispositions.finding: Reject ordinal sufficiency; retain edition-bound block IDs or snapshot/representation-bound locator alternatives.
Reject live URL sufficiency; bind the displayed edition/passage and reauthorize resolution.
Reject reindex-only labels and still-servable snippets; establish fresh authorization before disclosure.
Retain lexical+dense fusion as evaluated hypothesis; relevance never defines authority.
Condition current default search and historical retention on policy status, current exact-edition access and explicit state.
Reject silent related-heading fulfillment; retain original or authorized unavailable outcome with separate navigation.
Add source/index/ACL generations and failure states; tests remain proposed.

source_family_scope: Every consequential source family present in the complete final and preserved maps, as bounded in primary-source-index.json; no claim to every possible source/history.

source_families.family: OpenSearch DLS / role composition / exact identity mapping

definition: COMPLETE means all consequential obligations/claims in the declared frozen planning package were assessed; not all possible history, recall or deployed behavior.
